title: 3 Kesalahan Video Produk HP yang Bikin Orang Tidak Jadi Beli

slides.headline: Video produk kamu terlihat "murah"?
slides.body: HP mahal tidak menjamin video terlihat mahal. Masalahnya mungkin bukan di kameranya, tapi 3 kesalahan dasar ini.
slides.image_prompt: A modern smartphone mounted on a mini tripod filming a sleek product on a clean dark table, cinematic lighting accent, professional studio aesthetic
slides.layout: Bold typography hero title with smartphone graphic background

slides.headline: 1. Lighting Asal-Asalan
slides.body: Kamera HP sangat bergantung pada cahaya. Mengambil video di ruangan remang atau membelakangi lampu membuat gambar pecah dan berbayang keras.
slides.image_prompt: Split comparison layout showing dark noisy product footage on the left vs bright soft-lit product footage on the right shot with smartphone
slides.layout: Before and After side-by-side comparison card

slides.headline: 2. Cuma Ambil 1 Angle Static
slides.body: Penonton cepat bosan jika hanya melihat 1 sudut pandang dari awal sampai akhir. Variasikan visual agar video terasa dinamis.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic showcasing three different camera angle frames of the same product: establishing shot, detail close-up, and dynamic side angle

slides.headline: 3. Kamera Panning Terlalu Cepat
slides.body: Gerakan HP yang patah-patah dan terlalu cepat buat mata lelah. Gunakan pergerakan lambat, stabil, dan tanpa transisi 3D berlebihan.
slides.image_prompt: Minimalist graphic depicting smooth movement vectors around a product with a stability indicator aesthetic
slides.layout: Educational infographic card with warning icons

slides.headline: Gunakan Pola 4 Shot Sederhana Ini
slides.body:
Shot 1: Establishing (produk & konteks)
 Shot 2: Detail tekstur/bahan
 Shot 3: Fitur/pemakaian
 Shot 4: Result/Call to Action
slides.image_prompt: Modern UI checklist featuring a 4-step video shot list formula for product videos

slides.headline: Ingin Video Produk Kamu Terlihat Seperti Iklan TV?
slides.body: Biar Bos Sony Creative Studio yang sulap rekaman HP kamu jadi video jualan berkelas. DM 'EDIT' sekarang untuk konsultasi gratis!
slides.image_prompt: Sleek promotional graphic showing a professional editing timeline interface on a laptop laptop screen, moody blue and warm highlight accents
slides.layout: High-converting Call To Action layout with brand offer card
